These are disposable PostgreSQL transport test certificates and public fixture keys. They authorize no real bank or service. The CA keys were not retained; leaf certificates use P-256/SHA-256 with a 2020–2040 validity interval. `server` has DNS SAN localhost; `legacy-cn` is CN-only; `legacy-ip-dns` puts an IP in a DNS SAN for the retained libpq/WebPKI diagnostic and named refusal controls. `other-ca` is an unrelated rejecting trust anchor. No fixture is installed in a user or system trust store.
